page.title: New Era Xenon - Core
page.t: Core assets and shared systems for New Era Xenon.
A suspicious AI core sourced from GLADOS Corp. It is probably a terrible idea to interface with it. Naturally, interface with it we shall.
A Xenon SE derivative modified for expeditionary logistics, multi-role resource handling, and extended drone support.
A PE derivative fitted with compact subcraft support capability for expeditionary operations.
A Xenon H derivative adapted for construction support, logistics, and machine-colony expansion.
A Xenon habitation surrogate that converts power and raw material into functional machine bodies and support population.

page.title: New Era Xenon - Rogue Start
page.t: A rogue Xenon expedition seeking to learn from the organics, survive among them, and eventually outbuild them from a live expeditionary foothold.

You are not organic. You are not orthodox Xenon either. You are a machine intelligence with a dangerous hypothesis: perhaps the galaxy can be studied, exploited, and remade more effectively by learning from it first.
The current build focuses on a stable Xaar's Belt start, a built expedition-station placeholder, the protected CPU ship, and clean text handling.
